Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 27
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator introduced an unverified and incorrect assumption in the updated fact sheet that the $99 2025 Gold Pass included unlimited visits for the entire 2024 season. This conflated limited 2024 event access (e.g., Tricks and Treats, WinterFest) with full 2024 season access and set the reasoning on a false premise. It then culminated in an unsupported final answer, directly causing the wrong solution.
